import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, Polygon
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 12, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(5.8, 4.4)) ax = fig.add_axes([0.035, 0.055, 0.93, 0.91]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_axis_off()
blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" purple = "#9273B5" ink = "#263238" gray = "#A9B5BA"
# Schematic dimensionless vectors, not measured data. a = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]) b = np.array([1.1, 0.0, 0.78]) parallel = np.dot(a, b) * a perpendicular = b - parallel cross = np.cross(a, b) double_cross = np.cross(a, cross)
# An orthographic view of the actual three-dimensional construction. elevation = np.deg2rad(25.0) screen_right = np.array([np.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0, -0.5, 0.0]) screen_up = np.array([ 0.5 * np.sin(elevation), np.sqrt(3.0) / 2.0 * np.sin(elevation), np.cos(elevation), ])
def project(v): return np.array([np.dot(v, screen_right), np.dot(v, screen_up)])
origin = project(np.zeros(3)) A, B, P, Q, C, D = map( project, (a, b, parallel, perpendicular, cross, double_cross) )
# A very light plane patch distinguishes the in-plane decomposition # from the cross product, which leaves that plane. ax.add_patch(Polygon( [origin, P, B, Q], closed=True, facecolor=blue, alpha=0.045, edgecolor="none", zorder=0 ))
def vector(start, end, color, width=2.0, style="-", scale=13, zorder=3): patch = FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=scale, linewidth=width, linestyle=style, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, capstyle="round", joinstyle="round", zorder=zorder, ) ax.add_patch(patch)
# The projected component lies on the same axis as the unit vector. vector(origin, A, ink, width=1.85, zorder=3) vector(origin, P, teal, width=3.2, scale=14, zorder=4) vector(origin, B, blue, width=2.35, scale=15, zorder=5)
# A translated copy completes b = b_parallel + b_perp. vector(P, B, teal, width=2.1, scale=13, zorder=4) vector(origin, Q, teal, width=1.6, style=(0, (4, 3)), scale=11, zorder=3) ax.plot( [Q[0], B[0]], [Q[1], B[1]], color=gray, linewidth=1.0, linestyle=(0, (3, 4)), zorder=1 )
vector(origin, C, purple, width=2.15, scale=14, zorder=5) vector(origin, D, blue, width=2.15, scale=14, zorder=5)
# True three-dimensional right-angle marker at the projection point. h = 0.085 corner = np.array([ parallel - h * a, parallel - h * a + np.array([h, 0.0, 0.0]), parallel + np.array([h, 0.0, 0.0]), ]) corner_2d = np.array([project(v) for v in corner]) ax.plot( corner_2d[:, 0], corner_2d[:, 1], color=gray, linewidth=1.0, zorder=6 )
# The angle is defined in the original 3D plane, then projected. theta = np.arctan2(np.linalg.norm(perpendicular), np.dot(a, b)) angles = np.linspace(0.0, theta, 100) radius = 0.24 arc_3d = np.column_stack(( radius * np.sin(angles), np.zeros_like(angles), radius * np.cos(angles), )) arc_2d = np.array([project(v) for v in arc_3d]) ax.plot(arc_2d[:, 0], arc_2d[:, 1], color=ink, linewidth=1.0, zorder=6) theta_pos = project(np.array([ 0.32 * np.sin(theta / 2), 0.0, 0.32 * np.cos(theta / 2), ])) ax.text(*theta_pos, r"$\theta$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=13)
ax.scatter(*origin, s=17, color=ink, zorder=8) ax.text(-0.035, -0.045, r"$O$", ha="right", va="top", fontsize=11)
ax.text(A[0], A[1] + 0.07, r"$\mathbf{a}$", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=16, color=ink) ax.text(B[0] + 0.045, B[1] + 0.015, r"$\mathbf{b}$", ha="left", va="bottom", fontsize=16, color=blue) ax.text(-0.065, P[1] - 0.005, r"$(\mathbf{a}^{\top}\mathbf{b})\mathbf{a}$", ha="right", va="center", fontsize=12, color=teal) ax.text(0.57, 0.84, r"$\mathbf{b}_{\perp}$", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=14, color=teal) ax.text(C[0] - 0.035, C[1] + 0.06, r"$\mathbf{a}\times\mathbf{b}$", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=14, color=purple) ax.text(-0.57, -0.37, r"$\mathbf{a}\times(\mathbf{a}\times\mathbf{b})=-\mathbf{b}_{\perp}$", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=12, color=blue) ax.text(0.64, -0.055, r"$\mathbf{b}_{\perp}=\mathbf{b}-(\mathbf{a}^{\top}\mathbf{b})\mathbf{a}$", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=11.5, color=teal) ax.text(-1.12, 1.05, r"$\|\mathbf{a}\|=1$", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=11, color=ink)
ax.set_xlim(-1.22, 1.40) ax.set_ylim(-0.57, 1.20)
